newsitem.title: JAPAN: Keidanren says Y110-120/dlr reflects fundamentals.
newsitem.headline: Keidanren says Y110-120/dlr reflects fundamentals.

text.p: A rate of 110 to 120 yen to the dollar reflects the fundamentals of the Japanese economy, Shoichiro Toyoda, chairman of Japan's powerful business lobby Keidanren, told reporters on Monday.
"The current exchange rate of around 110 to 120 yen reflects Japan's economic strength," he said.
Asked about the recent surge of the yen against the dollar, Toyoda said: "Extreme fluctuations in the foreign exchange rate are not desirable."
